situation: A family group chat: parents and their two adult children.
topic: A full-blown row: the mother calls the eldest a disgrace, the eldest mocks her faith and swears at her, the father shouts them both down, and the younger sibling takes sides.

text: Leanne I've been thinking about what you said last Sunday about church and I really think you need to apologise 🙏
Mum I was just being honest, I'm not apologising for having an opinion
An opinion is one thing but the way you said it in front of everyone was really hurtful
I said I don't believe in it, that's not an attack on you personally
You said it was all made up Leanne. In front of Auntie Pat. That is an attack on me personally yes it is 😔
It IS all made up though, that's my view, I'm 32 not a child
Well I think that is a disgraceful thing to say and I think you need to have a good look at yourself
Oh brilliant, disgraceful, right
So I'm disgraceful for not believing in fairy tales, that's great mum thanks for that
Leanne don't
Dad she called me disgraceful
I know what she said
Fairy tales. That's what you think of something that means everything to me and your nan meant everything to her and her mother before that. Fairy tales.
I'm not saying it to hurt you I'm saying it because it's what I actually think, you asked me
I did not ask you I asked if you were coming to the carol service
And I said I wasn't because I think it's pointless, yes
Pointless. Right. 😢😢
leanne a bit harsh ngl 😬
Oh cheers shaun
just saying like it's mum
Yeah I know who it is
Mum I'm sorry it hurt you but I'm not going to pretend I believe something I don't
I never asked you to pretend anything. I asked you to come to one carol service with your family and you couldn't even do that without making me feel like an idiot for going 😔
I didn't make you feel like an idiot, god
Language please
Are you serious
Mum I swear to god all the time you know that
In this context yes I am serious actually
This is so typical, we can't have one actual conversation without it turning into you policing what I say
I am not policing you I am asking for basic respect in my own family
You want me to come to church and sit there pretending and you think that's respectful to you?? It'd be more disrespectful
Other people manage it. Your brother manages it.
mum don't bring me into it
Sandra leave it
I will not leave it Trevor she needs to hear this
She's heard it. You've both said it. Leave it now.
Yeah I think we're done here
We are not done. You come here at Christmas and sit at my table and eat my food and you can't give me one Sunday morning and you can't even be civil about it. I am your mother.
I know you're my mother
And I love you but honestly this is exhausting
Exhausting. I'm exhausting. That's lovely Leanne. Really lovely.
That's not what I said
Both of you. Enough.
She started it on a WhatsApp group dad
I don't care who started it
leanne just come to the carol thing it's one hour 😅
Shaun I'm not asking for your input cheers
just trying to help 🙃
Well don't
I just want my family together at Christmas. That is all I have ever wanted. And every year it gets harder.
We'll be together at Christmas. That's not in question.
Mum I will come to the carol service ok
But I'm not apologising to auntie pat because I didn't say anything to her, I said it to you
Thank you
Right then.
